name: New Zealand King Salmon Investments Limited
quirks: Balance date changed TWICE: to 31 Jan (FY2021 was a 7-month stub) and to 30 Sep (FY2025 an 8-month stub). Current FY ends 30 September; H1 FY2026 = 6mo to 31 Mar 2026.
Metrics CSV carries FY2021-7mo and FY2025-8mo stubs plus month-qualified FY2025-Jan / H1 FY2026-Jul / H1 FY2026-Mar. Never annualize a stub or compare across the balance-date changes.
EPS reported in DOLLARS, not cents.
Share count stepped 139m -> 541m at the 2022 post-mortality recapitalization, breaking per-share continuity.
Company guides on non-GAAP 'Pro-Forma Operating EBITDA' which diverges materially from GAAP EBITDA (H1 FY2026: GAAP 24.0 vs PF 17.2).
